name: Delivery_Roster
label: Delivery Roster
_about: The people and vehicles the nightly team rotation pairs up (spec Delivery 02, TM-R4: edited any time in the Control Panel). One row per installer, driver or vehicle. No row at all = the built-in roster in rotation.mjs (the same list the Daily Team Availability widget used to hold). Admin only. Seeded by the Delivery Settings page's 'Make the roster editable' button.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.helpText: A person's name, or a vehicle as it is written on the team row, e.g. Traviz (NIB-3823).

fields.name: Active
fields.label: Active
fields.helpText: Untick to take someone or something out of the rotation without deleting the row.

fields.name: Sort_Order
fields.label: Sort Order
fields.helpText: The rotation walks the list in this order, then by row. Changing the order changes who is paired with whom from the next night.
